edits.description: Targeted edits to the playground page, applied in this order.

op.description: replace: swap an exact block. append: add at the end. create: write the whole page — when it does not exist yet, and on a REGENERATION, where it overwrites the broken page.

find.description: Required by replace: the exact current text, copied verbatim with its whitespace, occurring EXACTLY ONCE in the file. Send an EMPTY STRING on append and create — the field is always present because a strict provider rejects a tool whose schema has an optional property.

content.description: The replacement text, the appended block, or the whole page on create.

why.description: One short line, in the user's language.

examples.description: ONLY on a regeneration (the prompt says so explicitly): the scenarios the page demonstrates, at least 6. Each example's key is what the page binds with {{playground.<key>.<property>}}, and code assembles the real state from these entries and substitutes it for the playgroundDinamicState token. Send an EMPTY ARRAY when amending an existing page — its state stays as it is.

name.description: Short scenario name, also the state key (camelCase, e.g. 'loading', 'noIcon').

state.description: State entries for this scenario. Empty when the scenario needs no state.
